chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Indeed, the follower of ʿAlī, peace be upon him, will see him in three places where that gladdens him: at death, at the Sirat, and at the Hawdh."

key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام
key_terms.مَوَاطِنَ: stations, places, or moments of encounter
key_terms.وَلِيَّ: the devoted follower or loyal adherent

ai.seo_question: Where will the follower of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام see him in the Hereafter?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the wali of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام will encounter him at three decisive moments of the afterlife journey: at death, at the Sirat, and at the Hawdh. It highlights the spiritual bond with Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and its joyful manifestation in the stages connected to the Hereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.369 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Indeed, the follower of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) will see him in three places that bring joy: at the time of death, at the Sirat (the bridge over Hell), and at the Hawdh (the Pool)."
